items.description: Inspired by vintage basketball styles, the Area Lo sneaker is handmade from LWG-certified leather, suede, and recycled polyester. This model is set on expanded rubber soles that are custom-molded with angular grooves and an ‘Arigato’ logo.
items.title: Area Lo Sneaker

items.description: The handmade Clean 90 Sneakers presents a timeless design with a subtle logo stamp in gold. The minimalist silhouette features a smooth leather upper in dark grey, set on a slightly higher rubber cup-sole equipped with cushioned footbed and arch support for maximum comfort.
items.title: Clean 90 Sneaker

items.description:
The London City T-Shirt is crafted from 100% organic cotton, offering a soft and breathable feel. Featuring a London script embroidery at the center chest. Made in Portugal, it reflects our commitment to craft and detail.

The model is 188 cm / 6'2 ft and wears a size M.
items.title: London City T-Shirt

items.description: The Dice Lo sneaker combines vintage and modern design details for a timeless, easy-to-style silhouette. Handcrafted from premium leather and recycled polyester, it has paneled uppers finished with perforations and a gold logo.
items.title: Dice Lo Sneaker

items.description: The Floral Washed Cap is made from 100% cotton with a washed texture for a worn-in look. It’s finished with seasonal embroidery, hand-distressed seams, and an adjustable strap with a metal slider.
items.title: Floral Washed Cap

items.description:
Experience unparalleled comfort with the Sky Sweatpants x Akaia RK, cut for a relaxed fit from 100% brushed-back cotton, offering a soft, breathable feel. An elasticated waistband with internal drawcords provides a personalized fit, while Reggieknow's signature and Akaia prints adorn the front. A single back pocket is intricately embroidered with 'Arigato'.

Sizes used on all models are M. Models are between 175cm – 187cm.
items.title: Sky Sweatpants x akaia RK

items.description: The Clean 90 Suede sneaker has a minimal, streamlined profile that is handcrafted in Portugal from butter-soft suede. This signature model is set on rubber cup-soles that are partly recycled, and stitched and glued to the uppers for durability. Discreet gold logos accent the sides.
items.title: Clean 90 Sneaker

items.description: The Area Lo sneaker pays homage to ‘90s basketball styles. Handcrafted from premium leather and recycled polyester, it has paneled uppers finished with perforations and heel spoilers.
items.title: Area Lo Fluffy Sneaker

items.description:
The Dice Lo sneaker combines vintage and modern design details for a timeless, easy-to-style silhouette. Handcrafted from premium leather, suede and recycled polyester, it has paneled uppers finished with perforations and a gold logo.

The surface of the vintage effect leather will wear off and expose the natural base leather for a worn effect. Rubbing while cleaning, in particular if wet, will accentuate the worn effect. If this is not desired, clean gently with dabbing movements and dry cloth to avoid abrasion on the surface.
items.title: Dice Lo Sneaker

items.description: Accented with tubular piping and flat laces, the Area Loop sneaker has a distinctive voluminous silhouette that nods to '90s design. It's handcrafted from premium suede with brushed panels for textural contrast.
items.title: Area Loop Sneaker

Crafted with a smooth, supple finish and clean architectural lines, it elevates daily looks without trying too hard. Designed to sit naturally on the shoulder, the curved opening and streamlined profile make it easy to carry from morning errands to evening plans. Finished with subtle gold detailing and a minimalist logo placement for a quietly confident statement.
